tco_heading: Want the productivity of in-person without the cost of an office?
tco_intro: Here's what a 10-person team actually pays to run their own office in Uptown Waterloo, versus the same 10 seats at Den 1880 Team Base.
team_vs_individual_heading: Team plans vs an individual Club Membership
team_vs_individual_intro: Team Starter is the same per-seat rate as a Club Membership. The team tier exists because a five-person team is not five people with five separate memberships, five invoices, and five separate onboardings. Here is what changes when you go team.
flex_heading: Team Flex vs single day passes
flex_intro: A single drop-in day pass is $45 (coworking only). Add the Performance Club gym and it's $85. Team Flex bundles workspace + Performance Club on every pass at $30-$38 each, plus pooling across your team. Here is what changes when you go team.
full_compare_intro: See exactly what each tier includes and where Enterprise picks up.
final_cta_heading: Bring your team in to see it.
final_cta_intro: We can accommodate tours daily, Monday to Friday. Walk the Library, Theatre, The Vault podcast studio, The Performance Club, and Teams Floor. Meet the Den 1880 team, grab an espresso, ask anything. No pressure.
